texts.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]一开始以为这是小行星，结果发现这其实是冰冻的、被压实的缇扬奇尸体，在轨道上历经几十年之后，成为一堆不成形状的块状物。整个小行星环，实际上，是一片露天墓地。其中的一部分尸体是最近刚刚到达并开始腐坏的，而剩下的已历经千年岁月，甚至比我们的帝国还要久远。
texts.en: What our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] first mistook for asteroids have been revealed to be frozen, battered Tiyanki corpses reduced to shapeless lumps after decades in orbit. The entire asteroid ring is, in fact, just an open burial ground. Some of the bodies we acquired are recently deceased, while others predate our empire by thousand of years.

texts.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]一开始以为这是小行星，结果发现这其实是冰冻的、被压实的外星动物尸体，其体型基本和在这个恒星系游荡的外星生命体一致。整个小行星环，实际上，是一片露天墓地。其中的一部分尸体是最近刚刚到达并开始腐坏的，而剩下的已历经千年岁月，甚至比我们的帝国还要久远。
texts.en: What our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] first mistook for asteroids have been revealed to be frozen, battered corpses of alien fauna, roughly matching the shape of the aliens seen roaming the system. The entire asteroid ring is, in fact, just an open burial ground. Some of the bodies we acquired are recently deceased, while others predate our empire by thousand of years.

  7100 "Open Burial": the asteroid ring is an open Tiyanki burial ground (+3 society); the text names the Tiyanki if communications with them exist.
